name: week
title: Regulatory change week
subtitle: Recorded changes and review dates. This is not a legal coverage opinion.

sections.title: New changes to assess
sections.sql: select external_id,title,owner,priority,review_due from v_change_desk where state='unassessed' order by review_due

sections.title: Actions to chase
sections.sql: select title,external_id,owner,due_date,state from v_action_desk where state<>'done' order by due_date

sections.title: Source coverage
sections.sql: select code,name,last_checked,state,owner from v_source_watch order by code

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select * from v_compliance order by rule,reference

sections.title: Sign-offs
sections.sql: select c.external_id,s.version,s.signed_by,s.reason from signoffs s join changes c on c.id=s.change_id order by c.external_id
